_note: IEC 62264 part of each B2MML file (owner 25.09., after customer 26.09.): the work files (Part 4: work definition, schedule, performance, capability, alert, record, workflow) and everything else Part 2 (resources, operations definition/schedule/performance/capability/test/event, work calendar, operational location). Common/infrastructure files have no part. lint-isa95 I18 checks a profile's isa95.part against the file its objectModel is defined in (isa95-b2mml.json files).
